cs.t: I have developed with several laptops and several Linux flavors during the years. But I will certainly recommend the Dell Studio 15 + Ubuntu. Drivers work without problems (just a small step to take with the wifi) and is quite stable. My partners that own MPB had problems with theirs during this time, plus if the need to have a presentation they need to carry additional HW.
